title: Futuro en el pasado: was going to, was about to, would

rule.title: The future in the past
rule.explanation:
Para hablar del futuro desde un punto del pasado:
- «was» / «were going to»: plan del pasado, a menudo no cumplido: «You were going to call me on Tuesday!»
- «was about to»: a punto de: «I was about to call you when…»
- «would»: futuro visto desde el pasado: «I was sure Mark would say no.»
- «was» / «were supposed to»: lo previsto, que no se cumplió: «We were supposed to have a short meeting.»
- «was to» (narrativo y formal): lo que iba a ocurrir después, como si fuera el destino: «I had no idea I was to come back as a business owner.»
- «was due to»: estaba programado: «The plane was due to land at six.»
- «was on the point of» + «-ing»: estaba a punto de (formal).

Más ejemplos:
- «I thought you would like it.»
- «We were going to go out, but it rained.»
- «She was about to leave when the phone rang.»

Ojo: «was to have» + participio expresa algo que estaba previsto y no ocurrió: «He was to have opened the conference, but he fell ill».

rows: I was going to call you.
It was supposed to be short.
It was due to start at nine.
